mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below its 12-month moving average predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days by signaling accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a 0.1 percentage point monthly rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises >0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A 50,000+ monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS falls >50000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days by indicating robust consumer spending supporting corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS is above its 12-month average over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO and HOUST both decline in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In strong industrial growth regimes (INDPRO > 0.5% MoM), a 0.1 percentage point monthly decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls >0.1pp in 1 month.
